_comment: Provenance + published-MA comparison sidecar for the finerenone bundle. Consumed by harness/make_bundle.py --meta.
data_provenance_note: Per-trial 2x2 event counts are the CV-composite event counts consistent with each trial's reported randomised N; the publishedHR/CI are each trial's reported primary/secondary CV composite hazard ratio. The harness proves the POOLING reproduces the app; it does not certify the count extraction — verify each 2x2 against the cited source before citing any pooled value.

provenance.source: Bakris GL et al. Finerenone in CKD and T2D (FIDELIO-DKD). N Engl J Med 2020;383:2219-2229
provenance.note: Secondary CV composite HR 0.86 (0.75-0.99); N 2833 finerenone / 2841 placebo

provenance.source: Pitt B et al. Cardiovascular events with finerenone (FIGARO-DKD). N Engl J Med 2021;385:2252-2263
Solomon SD et al. Finerenone in HFmrEF/HFpEF (FINEARTS-HF). N Engl J Med 2024;391:1475-1485

published_comparison.label: FIDELITY pooled (FIDELIO-DKD + FIGARO-DKD) CV composite — NOTE: 2-trial subset, HR scale
published_comparison.source: Agarwal R et al. Eur Heart J 2022;43:474-484 (FIDELITY prespecified pooled analysis), doi 10.1093/eurheartj/ehab777
